basis.classification: ICB level 2 as served by Vietcap (vnstock Listing(source='VCI'))
basis.weighting: cap-weighted for every aggregate; no medians
basis.units: bn VND; returns and shares in %

fields.n_listed: Count of type=STOCK symbols on HSX/HNX/UPCOM with this icbCode2 in Vietcap price/symbols/getAll (delisted excluded; suspended/restricted included).
fields.mcap_bn_vnd: Σ close × listed shares from Vietcap price/symbols/getList (match price on 2026-10-30; reference price when no trade), bn VND. Understated where a stock is ex-rights with new shares not yet listed (e.g. TCB, 50% stock dividend, ex-date 2026-10-29).
fields.mcap_bn_vnd_vci: Cross-check: Vietcap's own ICB aggregate (market-watch/AllocatedICB/getAllocated, ONE_DAY, totalMarketCap + totalPriceChange, summed over HOSE+HNX+UPCOM groups). Higher than mcap_bn_vnd for Banks (+138.7 tn) and Industrial Goods (+12.1 tn): Vietcap appears to count shares not yet on the board.
fields.ret_1m_pct: Cap-weighted from constituents: Σ(listed shares × close 2026-10-30) ÷ Σ(listed shares × adjusted close on the last session on/before 2026-09-30) − 1; adjusted daily closes from Vietcap chart/OHLCChart/gap-chart; current share counts used for weights; stocks without a base close (new listings) excluded — see ret_coverage_pct (share of industry cap included).
fields.ret_ytd_pct: As ret_1m_pct with base = last session of 2025 (2025-12-31).
fields.ret_1m_pct_vci / ret_ytd_pct_vci: Cross-check: Vietcap's ICB change % (AllocatedICB, group ALL, timeFrames ONE_MONTH / YTD; cap-weighted Σ price change ÷ Σ base cap). Vietcap does not document the ONE_MONTH base date; its ICB figures are within ~3 pp of ret_* for every industry.
fields.foreign_own_pct: ≈ derived, not an ownership disclosure: Σ (totalRoom − currentRoom) × price ÷ Σ cap over constituents with foreign-room data on the Vietcap board (2026-10-30). Room data can lag corporate actions. Null when room data cover < 50% of industry cap (foreign_coverage_pct).
fields.top: 3 largest constituents by mcap_bn_vnd; ret_ytd_pct per stock = adjusted close 2026-10-30 ÷ 2025-12-31 − 1 (null for 2026 listings).
fields.top1_share_pct: Largest constituent's share of the industry's mcap_bn_vnd, %.
fields.note_vi / note_en: Descriptive one-liners written by the Investing agent from this file's figures (note_src = URL when a press/disclosure fact is used). Not advice.
fields.sample and recency (valuation, growth an: All keys below are ≈ derived aggregates (Σ over companies ÷ Σ over the same companies; no medians), computed by tools/build/industries_fundamentals.py valuation from Vietcap IQ quarterly statements (consolidated where the company has subsidiaries; as served by trading.vietcap.com.vn/api/iq-insight-service). TTM = each company's own latest four consecutive reported quarters ending Q3/2026 or Q2/2026 (older → excluded); year-earlier TTM = the four quarters ending one year before that company's end. Balance-sheet items at each company's latest reported quarter-end (Q3/2026 or Q2/2026). Caps = mcap_bn_vnd (close × listed shares, 2026-10-30). *_n = companies included; *_coverage_pct = their share of the industry cap. Not the exchange's or a broker's figures (those use index/free-float weights and their own EPS).
fields.pe: Σ market cap ÷ Σ TTM profit after tax attributable to parent shareholders (isa22; isa20 where isa22 is missing). Loss-makers INCLUDED (pe_loss_makers_n); null when the aggregate TTM profit ≤ 0 (pe_null_reason). Keys pe_n, pe_coverage_pct, pe_loss_makers_n.
fields.pb: Σ market cap ÷ Σ parent shareholders' equity (bsa78 less minority interests bsa210 where bsa78 includes them) at the latest quarter-end; companies with equity ≤ 0 excluded. Banks: book = parent equity. Keys pb_n, pb_coverage_pct.
fields.roe_pct: Σ TTM parent profit ÷ Σ latest parent equity over companies in both the pe and pb samples (roe_n); period-end equity, not average. Not a reported ROE.
fields.div_yield_pct: Σ cash dividends paid in the TTM ÷ Σ market cap of the same companies, %. Dividends = cash-flow statement line 'Cổ tức, lợi nhuận đã trả cho chủ sở hữu' (Vietcap cfa32, financing activities), each company's own latest four consecutive reported quarters ending Q3/2026 or Q2/2026 (older → excluded) of cash-flow statements (quarters are discrete in the source; a reported quarter with the line blank counts as 0). Stock dividends and bonus shares are not cash and are not in this line. In consolidated statements this line also includes dividends paid by subsidiaries to minority (non-controlling) shareholders — it cannot be separated in the source, so the yield is overstated for groups with large minority stakes; not adjusted. Cash paid ≠ declared: timing follows payment dates. div_n, div_payers_n, div_coverage_pct.
fields.net_margin_pct: Σ TTM parent profit ÷ Σ TTM revenue over the rev_yoy sample (net_margin_n). Banks' denominator is total operating income, brokers' net operating revenue, insurers' net insurance revenue — not comparable with non-financial industries.
fields.eps_growth_pct: Σ_i shares_now_i × TTM EPS_now_i ÷ Σ_i shares_now_i × TTM EPS_yearago_i − 1, with year-ago EPS restated to today's share count (so issuance/splits do not show as growth) — this reduces exactly to like-for-like TTM parent-profit growth over companies with both windows and share counts (eps_growth_n, eps_growth_coverage_pct). Vietcap's reported EPS (isa23) is not used: it is blank/0 for many companies and not split-adjusted. eps_growth_per_share_pct (supplementary) does NOT restate: shares = paid-in capital bsa80 ÷ VND 10,000 par at each window end, so any increase in shares (cash issues, stock dividends, conversions) counts as dilution; treasury shares not deducted.
fields.debt_to_equity: ×, non-financial industries: Σ interest-bearing debt ÷ Σ parent equity at the latest quarter-end, pb sample (de_n, de_coverage_pct). Debt = short-term borrowings & finance leases bsa56 + long-term borrowings & finance leases bsa71 + convertible bonds bsa173 (straight bonds issued are within bsa56/bsa71 in the VAS layout). Denominator is parent equity, so groups with large minority interests show a higher D/E than Vietcap's debtPerEquity (which divides by total equity incl. minorities, bsa78). Null for ICB 8300 Banks, 8500 Insurance, 8700 Financial Services (deposits/interbank/repo funding are operating liabilities); for those liab_to_equity = Σ total liabilities bsa54 ÷ Σ parent equity is given instead. Market value excludes those three industries.
fields.current_ratio: ×: Σ current assets bsa1 ÷ Σ current liabilities bsa55 at the latest quarter-end, pb sample with both lines (cr_n, cr_coverage_pct). Null for ICB 8300, 8500, 8700 (the bank/insurer/broker VAS formats do not split current/non-current, or not comparably).
fields.interest_coverage: ×: Σ TTM EBIT ÷ Σ TTM interest expense over companies in the rev_yoy sample that report interest expense > 0 (ic_n, ic_coverage_pct); ic_no_debt_n = companies with zero/blank interest expense (excluded). EBIT = profit before tax isa16 + interest expense isa8 ('Chi phí lãi vay', within financial expenses). Shown even if negative, with ic_negative_ebit = true. Null for ICB 8300, 8500, 8700.
fields.asset_turnover: ×: Σ TTM revenue ÷ Σ average total assets (bsa53, mean of the TTM-end quarter and four quarters earlier; latest only where the earlier one is missing — at_latest_assets_only_n), rev_yoy sample (at_n, at_coverage_pct). Null for ICB 8300, 8500, 8700.
fields.valuation caveats: (1) Double counting: a listed parent consolidating a listed subsidiary (VIC–VHM/VRE/VPL, MWG–DMX, GVR–PHR/DPR, GAS–PGD …) puts the subsidiary's profit, book, debt and dividends in both companies; cap is counted twice too, so ratios move roughly proportionally rather than in one direction, but the subsidiary's weight is overstated. (2) TTM timing: most cap uses Q4/2025–Q3/2026, the rest Q3/2025–Q2/2026 (see growth_quarter). (3) One-off gains (divestments, revaluations) in the window lower P/E and raise growth; quarterly reports are unaudited and may be revised. (4) Caps use listed shares; ex-rights shares not yet listed (e.g. TCB, ex-date 2026-10-29) understate cap. (5) Full listed universe incl. UPCoM and total (not free-float) cap — differs from VN-Index P/E. (6) Survivorship: today's constituents. Descriptive only, not investment advice.
fields.rev_yoy_pct, npat_yoy_pct, growth_quarte: Like-for-like TTM vs year-earlier TTM over companies with revenue and parent profit in all eight quarters (rev_yoy_n, rev_yoy_coverage_pct); revenue definitions as IND_ICB.fundamentals (net sales; banks total operating income; securities firms net operating revenue; insurers net insurance revenue). npat_yoy_pct null when the year-earlier aggregate profit ≤ 0. growth_quarter names the TTM end; a mixed sample is labelled 'mixed: TTM Q3/2026 (x% of sample cap), TTM Q2/2026 (y%) — each vs its own year-earlier TTM'. Differs from fundamentals.*_yoy_pct (TTM column), which uses one common window ending Q3/2026 and also requires total assets.
fields.roa_pct: %, ≈: Σ TTM parent-attributable profit ÷ Σ average total assets (bsa53, mean of the TTM-end quarter and four quarters earlier; latest only where the earlier one is missing — roa_latest_assets_only_n), P/E sample with assets (roa_n, roa_coverage_pct). Includes banks, insurers and brokers (for banks ROA is the usual measure; their balance sheets are 10× leveraged so ROA is far below other industries). Parent profit over total (incl. minorities') assets understates ROA slightly where minorities are large.

history.source: Vietcap chart/OHLCChart/gap-chart adjusted daily closes (vnstock Quote(source='VCI').history); current listed shares and ICB codes as in IND_ICB.industries. vnindex = VN-Index close at each year-end (same feed); vnindex_ret_pct ≈ derived from those closes.
history.basis_vi: Chỉ số giá ngành tự tính, gia quyền vốn hóa, theo các mã niêm yết HIỆN NAY (HOSE/HNX/UPCoM, phân ngành ICB cấp 2 của Vietcap). Giá: giá đóng cửa điều chỉnh hằng ngày của Vietcap (chart gap-chart; cùng nguồn vnstock Quote VCI) tại phiên cuối mỗi năm (năm 2026 = phiên 2026-10-30, tức từ đầu năm đến nay). Lợi suất năm Y = Σ(số CP niêm yết hiện tại × giá ĐC cuối Y) ÷ Σ(số CP hiện tại × giá ĐC cuối Y−1) − 1, chỉ gồm mã có giá ở cả hai thời điểm; tức là gia quyền theo vốn hóa đầu năm ước tính (giá ĐC × số CP hiện tại), tái cân bằng mỗi năm. Chỉ số = 100 tại cuối 2018 (hoặc năm đầu tiên có dữ liệu), nối chuỗi các lợi suất năm. Mã chưa có giá thì bỏ qua; không nội suy. Chỉ là chỉ số giá (không cộng cổ tức tiền mặt trừ khi Vietcap đã điều chỉnh giá cho cổ tức tiền). Thiên lệch sống sót: chỉ gồm mã còn niêm yết hôm nay — mã đã hủy niêm yết/bị đình chỉ hẳn không có trong chuỗi, nên các năm đầu chỉ phản ánh những công ty tồn tại đến nay. Vốn hóa cuối năm (mcap_bn_vnd) chỉ là XẤP XỈ = giá ĐC × số CP hiện tại: giá ĐC đã chia cho cổ tức cổ phiếu/thưởng nên phần này gần đúng, nhưng phát hành thêm (chào bán, riêng lẻ, ESOP, sáp nhập) làm phóng đại vốn hóa quá khứ, và mã nay không còn niêm yết bị thiếu — không dùng như vốn hóa thị trường chính thức. n_with_data = số mã có giá tại cuối năm đó; cap_coverage_pct = tỷ trọng vốn hóa hôm nay của các mã đó.
history.basis_en: Self-computed cap-weighted industry price indices over TODAY's listed constituents (HOSE/HNX/UPCoM, Vietcap ICB level 2). Prices: Vietcap adjusted daily closes (chart gap-chart; the same feed as vnstock Quote VCI) on the last session of each year (2026 = session of 2026-10-30, i.e. year-to-date). Return in year Y = Σ(current listed shares × adj. close end-Y) ÷ Σ(current listed shares × adj. close end-(Y−1)) − 1 over stocks with both closes, i.e. weights = estimated year-start market cap (adj. close × current shares), rebalanced yearly. Index = 100 at end-2018 (or the first year with data), chain-linked from the yearly returns. Stocks without a price are skipped; nothing is interpolated. Price index (no reinvested cash dividends unless Vietcap's adjustment already strips them from past prices). Survivorship bias: only stocks listed today — delisted names are absent, so early years show only the companies that survived to today. Year-end market cap (mcap_bn_vnd) is APPROXIMATE = adj. close × current shares: adjusted prices already divide out stock dividends/bonus shares, but new issuance since (rights, private placements, ESOP, mergers) inflates past caps and delisted stocks are missing — not an official market capitalisation. n_with_data = constituents with a price at that year-end; cap_coverage_pct = their share of today's industry market cap.

data_screen.rule: daily move beyond ×1.5 or ÷1.5 that reverts to within 1% of the prior close within 5 sessions = feed artefact; ≥3 such flips → series dropped; otherwise a year-/month-end close inside a flip is treated as missing

history.built_from: Cloud sandbox, 2026-11-01: Vietcap gap-chart (ONE_DAY, countBack 2000 → first bar 2018-10-25 for VNINDEX) pulled one symbol per request for all 1,518 stocks (1,517 returned data; UTT none) and VNINDEX; history_block() from tools/build/industries_vnstock.py (vnstock not installed here).

end_2018.reported: > 3.9 mn bn VND (Ministry of Finance, as reported)

market_cap_approx_vs_reported.note: Approximation runs 3–6 % below the reported totals: delisted stocks are missing (survivorship), partly offset by later share issuance inflating past caps.

ytd_2026_vs_cards_ret_ytd_pct.why: history drops series failing the data screen (DNN, Utilities: adjusted close 2,962 → 41,600 YTD on a series that oscillates between two levels); the cards (built earlier) include it. Market YTD 0.34 % here vs 0.36 % on the cards for the same reason.

caveats_vi: Thiên lệch sống sót: chỉ các mã còn niêm yết ngày 30/10/2026; các năm đầu thiếu mã đã hủy niêm yết.

Mã niêm yết muộn chỉ vào chỉ số từ năm có giá: Dịch vụ tài chính (TCX, VCK, VPX — cuối 2025), Du lịch & Giải trí (VPL — 5/2025), Bán lẻ (DMX — 8/2026), Truyền thông (VNZ — 2023), Ngân hàng (MSB, SSB, OCB… — 2020–21); các năm có độ phủ < 60% vốn hóa hôm nay ghi ở low_coverage_years.
Tỷ trọng theo số CP hiện tại: doanh nghiệp phát hành thêm nhiều (chào bán, ESOP) bị gán tỷ trọng quá khứ lớn hơn thực tế.
Vốn hóa cuối năm là xấp xỉ (thấp hơn số công bố 3–6% ở cuối 2018 và 2024).
Lợi suất toàn thị trường (mọi sàn, gia quyền như trên) khác VN-Index (chỉ HOSE, phương pháp chỉ số chính thức).
caveats_en: Survivorship bias: only stocks listed on 30 Oct 2026; early years miss delisted names.

Late listings enter only from their first priced year-end: Financial Services (TCX, VCK, VPX — late 2025), Travel & Leisure (VPL — May 2025), Retail (DMX — Aug 2026), Media (VNZ — 2023), Banks (MSB, SSB, OCB… — 2020–21); years covering < 60% of today's cap are listed in low_coverage_years.
Weights use current share counts: companies that issued many new shares (rights, ESOP) get larger past weights than they actually had.
Year-end market cap is approximate (3–6% below reported totals at end-2018 and end-2024).
The all-market return (all three exchanges, weighted as above) differs from the VN-Index (HOSE only, official index methodology).
2026 runs to 30 Oct 2026 (not a full year).

fundamentals.units: bn VND (statement values in VND ÷ 1e9); ratios and growth in %; coverage = % of today's cap
fundamentals.source: Vietcap IQ financial statements (iq-insight-service, company/{SYM}/financial-statement, sections INCOME_STATEMENT and BALANCE_SHEET; field labels from /financial-statement/metrics), served via trading.vietcap.com.vn/api/iq-insight-service — one request per stock and section, pulled 2026-11-01; classification and today's caps as IND_ICB.industries.

fields.revenue_bn_vnd: Σ top line. Corporates: net sales (Vietcap isa3 'Doanh thu thuần'). Banks: total operating income (isb38 'Tổng thu nhập hoạt động' = net interest + fees + FX/securities + other). Securities firms: net operating revenue (isa3; isa1 if absent) — gross, includes FVTPL gains. Insurers: net revenue from insurance business (isi64), excluding financial-investment income. The market total therefore mixes these definitions.
fields.net_profit_bn_vnd: Σ profit after tax attributable to parent shareholders (isa22); PAT (isa20) used where isa22 is missing/zero but isa20 is not — count in pat_fallback_n.
fields.total_assets_bn_vnd: Σ total assets at fiscal year-end (bsa53); TTM = at the TTM quarter end.
fields.equity_bn_vnd: Σ parent shareholders' equity at period end (bsa78 less minority interests bsa210 where bsa78 includes them); companies with equity ≤ 0 excluded from this sum and from ROE.
fields.n_with_data: Companies with revenue, net profit and total assets for the period (all sums use this set).
fields.coverage_pct: Σ today's market cap of those companies ÷ today's industry cap, %.
fields.net_margin_pct: ≈ derived: net_profit ÷ revenue (null when revenue ≤ 0). Banks' denominator is operating income, not sales.
fields.roa_pct: ≈ derived: net_profit ÷ period-end total assets (not average assets).
fields.roe_pct: ≈ derived: Σ net profit ÷ Σ period-end parent equity over companies with equity > 0 (not average equity).
fields.revenue_yoy_pct / net_profit_yoy_pct: ≈ derived, like-for-like: Σ this period ÷ Σ previous period − 1 over companies with data in both (yoy_n_like_for_like); TTM vs the TTM one year earlier. Null when the base profit ≤ 0.
fields.top_profit_<FY> / top_profit_ttm: 3 largest positive net-profit contributors and their share of the industry total; largest_losses_* = 3 biggest loss-makers.
fields.templates: Count of constituents by statement layout detected (corporate / bank / securities / insurer).

fundamentals.basis_vi: Tổng hợp báo cáo tài chính theo ngành ICB cấp 2, gồm các mã đang niêm yết HÔM NAY trên HOSE/HNX/UPCoM (cùng danh sách và vốn hóa với IND_ICB.industries). Nguồn: báo cáo tài chính trên Vietcap IQ (số liệu VND, đổi sang tỷ đồng). Doanh thu: doanh thu thuần (DN thường); tổng thu nhập hoạt động (ngân hàng); doanh thu hoạt động thuần (CTCK, gồm lãi FVTPL); doanh thu thuần hoạt động kinh doanh bảo hiểm (DN bảo hiểm, không gồm thu nhập đầu tư tài chính). Lợi nhuận: LNST thuộc cổ đông công ty mẹ (dùng LNST nếu nguồn không tách). Tổng tài sản và vốn chủ sở hữu (của cổ đông công ty mẹ) tại cuối kỳ. Năm = năm tài chính theo nhãn của Vietcap; 12 tháng đến Q3/2026 = tổng 4 quý gần nhất, bảng cân đối tại cuối quý đó. Mỗi kỳ chỉ cộng các công ty có đủ doanh thu, lợi nhuận và tổng tài sản; thiếu thì bỏ qua, không nội suy. Biên lợi nhuận, ROA, ROE là tỷ số tổng (≈, tính từ số cuối kỳ). Tăng trưởng so cùng kỳ tính trên cùng nhóm công ty có số liệu ở cả hai kỳ.
fundamentals.basis_en: Financial statements aggregated by ICB level-2 industry over stocks listed TODAY on HOSE/HNX/UPCoM (same constituents and caps as IND_ICB.industries). Source: Vietcap IQ financial statements (VND, converted to bn VND). Revenue: net sales (corporates); total operating income (banks); net operating revenue (securities firms, incl. FVTPL gains); net revenue from insurance business (insurers, excl. investment income). Profit: PAT attributable to parent shareholders (PAT where not split out). Total assets and parent equity at period end. Years = fiscal years as labelled by Vietcap; TTM Q3/2026 = sum of the latest four quarters, balance sheet at that quarter end. Each period sums only companies with revenue, profit and total assets; gaps are skipped, never interpolated. Margin, ROA and ROE are aggregate ratios (≈, period-end denominators). YoY growth is like-for-like over companies reporting both periods.
caveats_vi: Thiên lệch sống sót: chỉ gồm mã đang niêm yết hôm nay; các năm đầu thiếu công ty đã hủy niêm yết, và thiếu công ty mới niêm yết sau này nếu nguồn không có báo cáo các năm trước.
Phân ngành theo mã ICB hiện nay, áp cho cả các năm trước.
Doanh thu toàn thị trường cộng các định nghĩa khác nhau (doanh thu thuần, thu nhập hoạt động ngân hàng, doanh thu CTCK/bảo hiểm) — chỉ nên đọc như tổng mô tả.
Tổng tài sản ngân hàng (chủ yếu là cho vay) chiếm phần lớn tổng tài sản toàn thị trường; ROA toàn thị trường vì vậy thấp và chịu chi phối của ngân hàng.

Số liệu hợp nhất khi công ty có công ty con (theo dữ liệu Vietcap); không loại trừ sở hữu chéo giữa các công ty niêm yết nên doanh thu/lợi nhuận/tài sản có thể bị đếm hai lần khi công ty mẹ và công ty con cùng niêm yết (ví dụ VIC hợp nhất VHM, VRE, VPL; MWG hợp nhất DMX; GVR hợp nhất PHR, DPR; GAS hợp nhất PGD) — tổng ngành Bất động sản và Bán lẻ bị ảnh hưởng rõ nhất.

Thay đổi phạm vi hợp nhất làm gãy chuỗi: từ 2026 FPT không còn hợp nhất toàn bộ FPT Telecom (FOX) (doanh thu 9 tháng 2026 của FPT 40.023 tỷ đồng theo phương pháp mới), nên số 12 tháng đến Q3/2026 của ngành Công nghệ không so sánh trực tiếp với 2025.
Năm tài chính không trùng năm dương lịch ở một số ít công ty: dùng nhãn năm của Vietcap.
Năm có độ phủ dưới 60% vốn hóa hiện tại của ngành được liệt kê trong low_coverage_years.
Tỷ số tính trên số cuối kỳ, không phải bình quân; có thể khác số công ty tự công bố.
12 tháng đến Q3/2026: chỉ gồm công ty đã có đủ 4 quý; báo cáo quý gần nhất có thể còn được điều chỉnh (soát xét/kiểm toán).
caveats_en: Survivorship: only stocks listed today; early years miss delisted companies, and miss later listings where the source has no earlier statements.
Classification uses today's ICB code for all years.
Market revenue adds different definitions (net sales, bank operating income, broker/insurer top lines) — read it as a descriptive total only.
Banks' balance sheets dominate market total assets, so market ROA is low and bank-driven.

Consolidated figures where the company has subsidiaries (as served by Vietcap); cross-holdings between listed companies are not eliminated, so revenue/profit/assets are double-counted where a listed parent consolidates a listed subsidiary (e.g. VIC consolidates VHM, VRE, VPL; MWG consolidates DMX; GVR consolidates PHR, DPR; GAS consolidates PGD) — Real Estate and Retail totals are most affected.

Changes in consolidation scope break series: from 2026 FPT no longer fully consolidates FPT Telecom (FOX) (FPT's 9M-2026 revenue VND 40,023 bn on the new basis), so Technology's TTM Q3/2026 is not directly comparable with 2025.
A few companies have non-calendar fiscal years: Vietcap's year label is used.
Periods covering < 60% of the industry's current cap are listed in low_coverage_years.
Ratios use period-end balances, not averages, and can differ from company-reported ratios.
TTM Q3/2026: companies with all four quarters only; the latest quarter can still be revised (review/audit).
